_comment_physics: Large-box dendrite with corrected anisotropy force. epsilon=0.10 gives A_max/A_min=1.10/0.833=1.32, sufficient for cubic arm development. delta=0.65 moderate undercooling for structured growth. Seed uses equilibrium tanh profile with uniform u=-delta (Karma & Rappel 1998).
_comment_grid: 384^3 = 56.6M cells. Memory: ~6 arrays x 452 MB = 2.7 GB, fits T4 (16 GB). dx=0.4 resolves the tanh interface over ~10 grid points (|phi|<0.9 band spans ~4.2 W0/dx = 10.4 cells).
_comment_time: Heun CFL margin: dt=0.005 vs dt_max=0.9*0.4^2/(6*D_eff)=0.01064 -> Heun limit ~0.0213 -> 4.3x margin. max_steps=40000 = 200 time units. Saturation guard exits cleanly when dendrite reaches boundary (typically step 6000-15000 on 384^3).
_comment_output: VTK every 500 steps. 384^3 VTS = ~880 MB each. With saturation at ~step 6000-15000, expect 12-30 frames = 10-26 GB disk.
_comment_checkpoint: Checkpoint every 2000 steps (~48s wall-clock on T4). 384^3 checkpoint = ~864 MB, keep_last=3 = ~2.6 GB disk.
_comment_initial: r0=10 cells = 4.0 W0, well above critical radius R_c = 2*d0/delta = 1.54 = 3.85 cells. Tanh initial profile avoids spurious interface-relaxation transient.
